Disaster Preparedness Youth Educator

Help teach families in Contra Costa County how to prepare for emergencies. Youth volunteers age 13 and up welcome with parental consent. Weekend commitments, 2 hours per session, training provided by chapter staff. Locations rotate between Walnut Creek, Danville, and San Ramon community centers.

Office Support Volunteer — Pleasanton

Assist chapter staff with data entry, mailing preparation, and event kit assembly. Flexible weekday afternoons, minimum age 14. A great first volunteer role for students building service hours. Supervisor provides verification letters for school service-hour programs on request.

Community Event Greeter

Welcome attendees at preparedness fairs and community events across the Tri-Valley. Youth age 13+ with an adult team lead present. Shifts are typically Saturday mornings, three hours, with setup and teardown support roles available for those who prefer behind-the-scenes work.

Youth Club Chapter Liaison

Represent your school's service club at monthly chapter coordination meetings. Open to high school students in good standing with an active school club affiliation. Virtual attendance option available on the first Tuesday of each month during the school year.

Parents are welcome at orientation sessions and may accompany volunteers under sixteen to any community-facing event.
